column4: cleat#2148: verifies claimWorkflowsOnce resets LOCK_TIMEOUT before ending its transaction rather than after (a reset attempted post-commit/rollback logged a false Error on every SQL Server claim tick), SQL Server only -- this job sets CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres) but no CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the test skips here on every run. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestMSSQLClaimWorkflowsOnceResetsLockTimeoutBeforeEndingItsTransaction -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one.
